notice: Indices are similarity indices from 0 to 100 on the stated measurements. They are not probabilities, confidence levels, percentages of identity or complete planetary analogies.

statuses.measured_comparable: Measured for both the planetary reference and the Earth candidate, with matching units, support and quality rules and a documented comparison method. Only this status can enter an index.
statuses.measured_context_only: Measured, but the two measurements fail at least one comparability check. Shown for interpretation, never scored.
statuses.source_available_unprocessed: A suitable public product exists but has not been processed for this AOI.
statuses.missing_earth: No usable Earth measurement for this AOI.
statuses.missing_planetary: No usable measurement for the planetary reference AOI.
statuses.incompatible: Measurements exist but answer different questions or cannot be put on a common basis.
statuses.review_pending: Processed, awaiting scientific review before it may be used.

field_test_suitability.label: Field-test suitability
field_test_suitability.method: Evidence record only. No numeric operational score is defined or validated.

terrain_analogy.label: Terrain analogy
terrain_analogy.question: Which processed Earth windows match the reference window's landform shape (slope, local relief, roughness, relative elevation) at 60, 120 and 240 m?
required_measurements: Slope, local relief, roughness and relative-elevation distributions for both AOIs from integrity-checked DEMs at 60, 120 and 240 m
terrain_analogy.ranking_conditions: Same reference AOI, terrain-v4.0, identical feature definitions, 60/120/240 m with a 1.2 km halo, equal family weights, SRTMGL1.003 for every Earth candidate.
terrain_analogy.permitted_conclusion: This Earth AOI matches the selected planetary AOI on the measured terrain features at the tested scales under terrain-v4.0.

balanced_science.label: Balanced science
balanced_science.question: Which Earth windows are the most useful general analogs across landform, materials and environment?
balanced_science.ranking_conditions: Terrain and geology must be measured_comparable for every candidate on one shared basis.
balanced_science.permitted_conclusion: Ranked general analog usefulness on the included dimensions only.

rover_mobility.label: Rover mobility
rover_mobility.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing rover mobility on terrain like the reference window?
required_measurements: Wheel-scale terrain (DEM at 1 m or finer) for traversability
rover_mobility.ranking_conditions: Requires regional terrain plus wheel-scale terrain and trafficability evidence. Wheel-scale evidence is part of field-test suitability, which has no comparable measurement yet.
rover_mobility.permitted_conclusion: Regional landform similarity only. No traversability or safety conclusion.

biosignature_fieldwork.label: Biosignature fieldwork
biosignature_fieldwork.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing biosignature research methods relevant to the reference site? This makes no claim about life.
biosignature_fieldwork.ranking_conditions: Geology and water/ice must be measured_comparable.
biosignature_fieldwork.permitted_conclusion: Method-testing relevance on included dimensions only.

mars_base_field_testing.label: Mars-base field testing
mars_base_field_testing.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing surface equipment under terrain and thermal stress like the reference site? This is not a landing, construction or base-siting recommendation.
required_measurements: Field-test logistics, access and safety evidence
mars_base_field_testing.ranking_conditions: Terrain and temperature must be measured_comparable, and field-test suitability must be documented.
mars_base_field_testing.permitted_conclusion: Equipment-testing relevance on included dimensions only.

profile_states.ranked: Every task-critical dimension is measured_comparable for every candidate on one shared basis.
profile_states.experimental_partial: Some task-critical evidence is missing. A partial index on the included dimensions is shown for exploration, without ranks and without a task conclusion.
profile_states.not_assessed: No task-critical dimension has comparable evidence. No index is shown.
